rbr_rules.antecedent: Ally Draft has >= 3 Heroes AND (Magic Damage Ratio < 15% OR Midlaner Missing)
rbr_rules.consequent: Force Absolute Priority: Wajib Rekomendasi Hero Mage / Midlaner di Puncak (#1)
rbr_rules.rationale: Aturan Komposisi Mutlak: Mencegah musuh menumpuk Physical Defense secara bebas.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.antecedent: Ally Draft has >= 3 Heroes AND Frontline / Tank Score < 30
rbr_rules.consequent: Force Priority: Wajib Rekomendasi Frontline / Roamer Tank
rbr_rules.rationale: Aturan Durabilitas Garis Depan: Mengamankan inisiasi kontes objektif Turtle & Lord.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.rationale: Bouncing ball membatalkan lintasan dash kabel dan menjatuhkan Ling dari dinding.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.rationale: Bouncing ball menginterupsi kabel baja berkecepatan tinggi secara konsisten.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.rationale: Lompatan Leap of Faith Freya memicu trigger pasif dan stun area.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.rationale: Blazing Duet memicu duri pasif bertubi-tubi dan taunt area mematikan.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.rationale: Implosion grouping dilanjutkan Real World Manipulation menghasilkan AoE wipeout.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Head-to-Head & Moonton Skill Dynamics

rbr_rules.antecedent: Enemy Draft memiliki >= 2 Late Game Scalers (e.g. Karrie, Claude, Cecilion)
rbr_rules.consequent: Draft Early-to-Mid Tempo Rushers (e.g. Terizla, Fanny, Suyou, Baxia)
rbr_rules.rationale: Selesaikan permainan sebelum menit 13:00 sebelum power spike late musuh tercapai.
rbr_rules.knowledge_source: MPL ID Season 18 Duration Correlation Analysis
